name: L’Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site
description: At the northern tip of Newfoundland, L'Anse aux Meadows holds the grass-covered outlines of eight turf-walled buildings that Norse voyagers raised about 1,000 years ago. It is the only undisputed Viking site in North America, predating Columbus by nearly five centuries. Excavations since the 1960s have uncovered over 800 objects, including bronze pins and traces of iron-making.
